text: Issue location text runs off the right edge of the 640x360 HUD: 'core drift 17% -37%/min under: roll' and 'sessions ... under: roll' are cut mid-phrase after pushing 7 s from the save start. Expected the full hint (e.g. 'under: roll it back') to fit or wrap.

The HUD line 'Rain: the path is slick' only appeared after ~16 s of game time (after patching core); at load (shots/start.png) the HUD said only 'spring' with faint streaks, and the sky was bright blue, so the shower/slick state was not visible at first. Also 'Noor is helping: on the way up, 2:30 left' did not count down at all across ~16 s of held keys.

Facing the boulder from its uphill side at dusk in rain: the module facets are a near-uniform dark purple/navy; only the crosshair prompt tells me I'm on 'router'. Module borders are hard to make out and the 'sessions ... far side' issue gives no visible glow from here.

Issue direction hint for 'sessions' flips between 'right' and 'far side' as I circle the boulder (below-left: 'right'; step 1 m to the right and face it: 'far side'; from uphill: 'far side'). Spent ~2 minutes walking around a 2 m boulder without ever getting the crosshair on sessions. Expected the hint to lead me to it (e.g. an arrow or glow I can walk toward).

After 8 s more pushing (~4 m, 26->22 m), the 'Rain: the path is slick' line vanished, Noor arrived ('waiting for it to settle, 2:28 left' - the timer finally moved), and a new issue 'auth certificate 66% -62%/min left' appeared. The HUD Noor line now overflows the right edge ('2:28 left' clipped). Pushing on the wet slope moved the boulder only ~0.5 m/s.

At 4 open issues, the HUD shows only the worst (auth 29%) then '... and 3 more lines' - I can no longer see which other modules are failing or where they are. Room on screen exists below. Also the boulder sat 'under 1 m' from the terrace after 10 s of pushing; the last metre took a separate push.

Nightfall on the 1.2 terrace, behind-view (V): the boulder is a near-black silhouette against a dark hill; I can only find it by the floating purple 'sessions' label and the outline. Sisyphus himself is barely visible. HUD text stays readable, but the world does not; at night I steered purely by HUD and labels.

Night, behind-view, lined up to push from below: the boulder is almost entirely hidden behind Sisyphus's dark body and blends into the dark hill; only the module prompt ('mailer: nearly new') confirms I'm touching it. Getting back below the boulder after Noor's visit took ~4 tries of walk-turn-screenshot; the 'The boulder: 7 m to your left' line helped.

Pushing on the 1.2 terrace at night: three 6-10 s holds of W did nothing (33 m stayed 33 m) because I was ~50 px off centre; the 'Not lined up to push' hint only shows sometimes (it was replaced by the module prompt in first person), so in first person I got no feedback at all while W did nothing. Expected either a tolerant push cone or the not-lined-up hint to always win over 'Nothing to patch'.

Good: on the slope at night the module with an open issue (core, flaky test) glows bright purple with white sparks and a floating 'core' label, clearly readable against the dark faceted boulder; the issue list is easier to trust at night than at dusk.

Shipped 1.3 at night (Users 740, Modules 16). In first person against the boulder at night the whole view is a featureless near-black wall; no facets or module borders visible, only the HUD. 'core flaky test far side' plus '... and 2 more lines' gives no way to know what the other two issues are.
